final_text: I added an Embedded Python block after the low-pass filter that outputs x * x, and a File Sink writing it to squared.dat. A run gives a mean of about 0.18 and a maximum of about 0.36 (the 5.8 kHz tone at 0.6), never below 0. I saved the block to the library as square_law (label Square Law) and saved the flowgraph. quantized.dat is unchanged.
